note: This file is the machine-readable form of the accepted dependency rules. Changing it is an architectural change and requires an ADR (ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md §3.1).

presentation.rationale: ADR-0001 §Decision 5 + PRODUCT_SPEC.md §8.4. The UI may consume only application contracts — never a domain context, never platform persistence, never a seed file. React and react-dom are the presentation runtime named by ADR-0001 §Decision 7 and scoped by ADR-0017; no other package, and no client-side router, state library or charting library, may enter this layer.

app.rationale: ADR-0005 §1. The Application layer is the authorization enforcement point and the only orchestrator of contexts.

contexts.rationale: ADR-0001 §Decision 5. Domain contexts depend downward on platform and sideways only through published public surfaces, per the per-context allow-lists below.

platform.rationale: ADR-0002 §Decision 1 names an arbitrary-precision decimal library. It is confined to the platform layer so no context can reach a raw Decimal.

tiers.0: Support — depended upon, depends on nothing but platform
tiers.2: Domain facts (L1), some producing first-order derived values

identity.why: ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md §4.2. Identity is referenced by id everywhere and imports nothing.

organization.owns: Legal entities, business units, geographies, hierarchy
organization.why: Structural fact. Other contexts hold organisational ids as opaque values (ADR-0001 §Decision 3).

portfolio.why: Owns membership only. MET-PORT-001..008 are aggregation RULES owned here but executed over inputs supplied by the Application layer, so Portfolio never imports Financial/Health/Forecast. See ADR-0012 (Proposed) and CONFLICT C-1.

project.owns: Project identity, lifecycle, engagement model, dates
project.why: Holds organisational and portfolio ids as opaque references.

contract.owns: As-sold baseline, executed changes, pending changes, contractual terms
contract.why: ADR-0003 §1. Sole owner of baseline derivation; duplicating it elsewhere is a boundary violation.

financial.owns: Actuals, revenue recognition, cost, ETC/EAC, margin, FX
financial.why: Every MET-FIN variance names a baseline (METRIC_CATALOG.md §1.1 rule 6), and baselines live in Contract.

delivery.owns: Milestones, scope items, schedule, progress, EVM inputs
delivery.why: Schedule variance is measured against the contractual schedule baseline.

commercial.owns: Rates, pricing, invoicing, receivables, unsecured upside
commercial.why: MET-FIN-011 unsecured upside derives from pending change records owned by Contract. Emits L2: MET-COM-007/008/009 are registered L2_DERIVED with owner Commercial, and CommercialSnapshot has declared them since Phase 2. Corrected from L1-only at Phase 8 closure (ADR-0022 D-2, CONFLICT C-21).

quality.owns: Defects, escapes, coverage, rework, engineering signals
quality.why: Self-contained fact domain. Emits L2: MET-QUA-003/006/009/011/012 are registered L2_DERIVED with owner Quality, and QualitySnapshot has declared them since Phase 2. Corrected from L1-only at Phase 8 closure (ADR-0022 D-3, CONFLICT C-21).

resource.owns: Assignments, utilisation, pyramid, attrition, key-person concentration
resource.why: Self-contained fact domain. PERSONAL_DATA classification applies (SECURITY_MODEL.md §4.3). Emits L2: MET-RES-001..010 are registered L2_DERIVED with owner Resource, and ResourceSnapshot has declared them since Phase 2. Corrected from L1-only at Phase 9 under ADR-0022 D-1 — the same stale-entry pattern C-21 resolved for Commercial and Quality.

risk.owns: Risk register, exposure, proximity, mitigation state
risk.why: Self-contained fact domain with first-order exposure derivation.

assurance.owns: Reviews, findings, audit records, evidence retention
assurance.why: Reads the platform audit sink; never reaches into business contexts.

rules.owns: Versioned rule definitions, thresholds, weights, explanations, and the metric registry
rules.why: ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md §4.1 rule 5 — Rules is depended upon and depends on nothing. Phase 2 placed the metric registry here for the same reason thresholds live here: a metric definition is versioned, effective-dated configuration that many contexts consume and none may fork.

integration.owns: Adapter seams and ingestion contracts (POC: synthetic loader only)
integration.why: Publishes canonical staged records. It must not import its consumers, or the adapter seam becomes a coupling. See ADR-0008 (Proposed).

health.owns: Composite scoring, RAG assessment, divergence, contribution breakdown
health.why: METRIC_CATALOG.md §8 — MET-HLTH-001..006 read exactly these six fact domains, with thresholds and weights from Rules.

data-quality.why: Defines a DataQualityProbe port that fact contexts implement and the Application layer registers, so it does not import eleven contexts. See ADR-0012 (Proposed).

recovery.owns: Recovery plans, recovery baselines, intervention outcomes
recovery.why: A recovery baseline is measured against contractual scope and schedule and closes risks. DQ-4 may retire this context after Phase 10.

forecast.why: METRIC_CATALOG.md §9 declares Forecast L3 inferred; ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md §4.2 lists it L2. Resolved by ADR-0004 §Consequences and ADR-0011 (Proposed) — see CONFLICT C-2. MET-FCST-001/006 read Health, MET-FCST-004 reads Financial.

ai-intelligence.why: ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md §4.1 rule 4 and ADR-0004 §3. It declares ports and the Application layer injects authorised implementations. This is what makes AC-6 testable.

explainability.owns: Rule evaluation and explanation shapes (REQ-HLTH-006, AC-3)

audit.owns: Append-only audit record and sink contract (ADR-0005 §6); records the ruleVersion in force

persistence.owns: Unit of work, repository and migration contracts (ADR-0001 §Decision 3)

observability.owns: OpenTelemetry-shaped traces, metrics and structured logs, with a redaction guard (Phase 5; ADR-0009 remains Proposed and no OTel package is imported)

sourceGates.description: Domain and application code must take time from the injected Clock, never ambient system time.
No float coercion in domain, application or presentation code. Money is decimal-safe by construction, and a component that parses a number is a component that has started computing one.

No production source file may import the Phase 3 generator or its recomputation oracle. The oracle exists only to prove the generated L1 facts are mathematically coherent; the Phase 4 engines must be implemented independently from the metric registry. If it became a shared calculation library, an engine would be validated against the thing that produced its inputs.

No dynamic code execution or process spawning anywhere in the product source. eval, the Function constructor, child_process and vm turn a data-injection bug into remote code execution, and nothing in this product needs any of them.
No ad-hoc colour literals; colour comes from design tokens. The single exempt file is the palette itself — the one place a brand hex value is allowed to exist (BRAND_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §1).
Presentation modules must carry the DEMO - SYNTHETIC DATA marker constant, never a hand-typed string. A marker someone can typo is a marker someone can omit.

Browser APIs belong to the presentation layer alone. Domain, application and platform code must never reach for the DOM, web storage or the navigator — the DOM lib is enabled repository-wide so React can be typed, and this gate is what stops that convenience becoming a coupling. The pattern targets browser *members* rather than the bare identifier `window`, which is a legitimate domain term here (a rate-limit window, a trajectory window) and must stay usable.
